summary: Exhaustive end-to-end testing of the CuminJar auth stack (email+password + Google + OTP + password reset). Executed 19 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_auth_flow_full.py (100% pass) plus the existing test_email_password_auth.py (9/10 pass — 1 unrelated non-auth failure). Frontend Playwright covered /login (correct+wrong password), session persistence across refresh, logout via user dropdown, forgot-password flow (email → 6-digit code entry step), Google Sign-In redirect to auth.emergentagent.com, and /get-started signup page render. All critical auth behaviour works. Cookie flags verified: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None, Path=/, Max-Age=604800. password_hash never leaked in /auth/login, /auth/register, or /auth/me responses. Brute-force lockout at 5 attempts (429) confirmed. OTP wrong-code increments attempts and locks at 5 (429). Expired OTP → 400. /auth/me returns 401 without cookie, with fake cookie, and after logout. PATCH /auth/me updates name+language and ignores non-whitelisted fields. logout-all-devices removes ALL user sessions.

minor.issue: Review request lists field name 'preferred_language' but backend whitelist is 'language'. Not a bug — the frontend/api uses 'language' — just a doc mismatch in the review request. Both tested, only 'language' is honoured.

issues: Inputs and 'Send verification code' button are missing data-testid attributes (signup-email-input, signup-name-input, signup-send-code-btn not present). Recommended to add for future automated testing.

action_items: Optional: Add data-testid attributes on /get-started inputs (signup-email-input, signup-name-input, signup-password-input, signup-send-code-btn) and Google button (signup-google-btn) for symmetry with /login testids.

Note (from regression run of test_email_password_auth.py::TestFirstRunEmptyScoping::test_new_user_has_empty_collections): A newly-registered user auto-gets a default family (Test's Family) so /api/families is not empty. Test is stale — the current behaviour is intentional (backend auto-provisions the first family and the frontend routes new users into FirstRunEmptyState based on recipes+stories being empty). Suggest updating that specific assertion in the older test file. Not in the scope of the current auth review.
critical_code_review_comments: All auth endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB '_id' and 'password_hash' from responses (find_one projection {'_id': 0, 'password_hash': 0}).
_check_brute_force uses ip+email AND email-only counters which is robust behind a load-balancer that rotates IPs.
Cookie is set with SameSite=None + Secure + HttpOnly — correct for cross-origin usage.
OTP + reset-OTP code_hash is SHA256 (fine for one-time codes with 5-attempt lockout).
Session token uses secrets.token_urlsafe(32) — cryptographically secure.
forgot-password returns 200 for nonexistent emails (no user enumeration) — implemented correctly.
Minor: /auth/logout deletes only the current session (correct); /auth/logout-all-devices deletes every session for the user (correct).
test_credentials: testuser2@example.com / TestPass123 (pre-seeded, works). Additional per-test users seeded on-the-fly via db.email_otps + POST /auth/register with cleanup fixtures.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test emails matching /test_epw_*@cuminjar.test/ and /test_flow_*@cuminjar.test/ — all cleaned up by pytest fixtures. login_attempts / user_sessions / email_otps / password_reset_otps rows are purged after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_auth_flow_full.py is the canonical auth regression suite for iteration 11 (19 cases across OTP, login, /auth/me GET+PATCH, logout, logout-all-devices, forgot-password, reset-password edge cases). Run with: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_auth_flow_full.py -o addopts=''` (the -o override is needed because /app/backend/pytest.ini adds -n auto which errors on empty selection). Frontend flows validated: login, wrong password toast, session persistence via cookie reload, logout via 'Log out' menu item under [data-testid='user-menu-trigger'], forgot-password 2-step flow (email → 6-digit code), Google redirect to auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/app. Existing test_email_password_auth.py has one stale FirstRunEmptyScoping assertion (families collection is not empty because backend auto-creates a default family on register). Not an auth bug.
